ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_delta_rank_weighted_margin_normalized
ir.intuition: Inject explicit normalization by weighting the negative logsigmoid loss with the pair weights and normalizing by total weight, combined with clamping for stability, to ensure scale-invariance and stable gradient magnitudes relative to the effective sample size.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
weighted_margin = alpha * margin - beta * delta_rank
clamped_margin = clamp(weighted_margin, -20, 20)
loss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(clamped_margin)
weighted_loss = loss_per_pair * weight
loss = sum(weighted_loss) / (sum(weight) + epsilon)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 0.1)))

    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    weighted_margin = ops.sub(ops.mul(alpha, margin), ops.mul(beta, delta_rank))
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(weighted_margin, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(clamped_margin))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)
    norm = ops.sum(weight) + eps
    loss = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), norm)
    return loss
